{{Quote|Lieutenant Avrey? We have a mission.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
'''Avrey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] communications [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served onboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], Avrey remained on the cruiser, repairing [[Time/Legends|decade]]-old technology as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had jammed all communications on the ''Indomitable'', ''Pioneer'' and ''Coruscant Sky''.

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], she was present with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] onboard the [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']]. She was instructed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] to remain on the ship when the Republic fleet made their way to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] and prepare for their defense against the Separatist fleet under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. When the fleet came out of hyperspace, Avrey saw that the internal and external communication systems from the fleet were not working and discovered that it was virus which was activated by Grievous. After proposing a solution, she was able to repair the technology, allowing the fleet to successfully win the battle. After the battle ended, she asked Obi-Wan to secure a connection to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
